notes_for_editor: The FCC tower registration (Siler City Fire Tower Road, 36.6 m, constructed January 2001) sits about 26 m from the list point (our calculation), so it is the strongest lead, but nothing we read says it is a lookout or that it replaced one. EZ1268 is a survey point, and the NGS sheet describes no tower. The Cellular Finder page mirrors FCC data and was read there, not at the FCC site. A Facebook group post with 'Siler City Fire Tower' in its title returned only the title. The list point is about 3.5 km south-west of the Wikipedia coordinates for the town (our calculation). Check with Chatham County or the NC Forest Service whether a lookout stood here before deciding on the 2001 structure. Not in NHLR or FFLOS in our data.
